sections.description: A complete, white-label loyalty and referral program for WooCommerce. Customers earn points on every purchase, redeem them for dollar-value discounts at checkout, and invite friends via unique referral codes. Includes a floating rewards widget, in-cart / checkout banners, a My Account rewards tab, 5 transactional emails, HPOS-compatible order handling, admin analytics with Chart.js, CSV import/export, direct WPLoyalty migration, and a credit-on-signup queue for pending customer balances. Fully theme-agnostic — every store-visible element is override-safe against aggressive theme CSS.
sections.changelog:
1.6.0

Added

  • Guest orders earn points. Until now a guest checkout earned nothing. When a guest order completes, its points go to the account with the same billing email; if there isn't one, they're held for that email and added, as that order's earn, when the customer creates an account with it. Refunds before then shrink the hold in the usual proportion and cancellations release it; after the account exists, the order behaves exactly like a member's (a refund taken while held appears as its own deduction). The order confirmation page and the customer's processing, on-hold and completed emails tell the guest how many points the order earns and how to collect them. On by default: Settings → Ways to earn → Points on guest orders
  • Ways to earn: an on/off switch for every way of earning. A new first settings tab switches points on orders, guest orders, the sign-up, first-order, birthday and review bonuses, referrals, each follow network and the email list reward on or off. Switching one off keeps its amount, so it comes back as it was, and it's honoured everywhere: nothing is paid, and the widget, Rewards tab, product and cart badges, emails, Omnisend properties and wcle_get_program() stop mentioning it. Turning referrals off also stops referral links and codes from working, hides the checkout field and thank-you prompt, takes a friend discount already in a cart back out, and pays no referrer rewards. An amount field whose feature is switched off says so. Everything is on after updating, so stores keep working as before
  • Follow rewards. Points for following the store on Instagram, Facebook or TikTok: set a profile URL and a reward per network (Settings → Bonuses) and a Follow button appears in the rewards widget and on the Rewards tab. Opening the profile credits the reward once per account per network; visitors who aren't signed in are invited to join. The networks don't let stores see who follows them, so by default only customers with a completed order (placed signed in, or a guest order whose points went to their account; a matching email alone doesn't count, since account emails aren't verified) can claim it; others see "Unlocks after your first order", and clicking anyway is refused. Settings → Ways to earn → Follow and email-list rewards need a completed order
  • Email list reward. Points for joining the store's email list, checked against Omnisend. Under "More ways to earn" on the Rewards tab (and linked from the widget), the customer sees the email it goes to and presses Subscribe: they're looked up in Omnisend, subscribed if they aren't already, with their consent recorded (source loyalty-rewards, time, IP, browser), and paid only once Omnisend shows them as subscribed. Customers already subscribed can claim it too; nothing else on their contact changes. If Omnisend still shows them unsubscribed (for example, waiting on a confirmation email), nothing is paid and they can press again later. The consent line names the store and the address. Once per account (claims are serialised with a database lock, as are follow rewards, so simultaneous requests can't pay twice), and under the same completed-order rule as follow rewards. Shows when an amount is set (Settings → Bonuses → Email list reward) and Omnisend for WooCommerce is connected; the wcle_omnisend_sync_enabled filter returning false (for staging copies) hides it along with the sync
  • Omnisend sync. With the Omnisend for WooCommerce plugin connected, each member's Omnisend contact carries loyalty_points, loyalty_points_value, loyalty_points_value_formatted, loyalty_lifetime_points, loyalty_referral_code, loyalty_referral_link and loyalty_member, refreshed whenever their balance changes, and loyalty_points_earned, loyalty_points_redeemed, loyalty_points_expiring and loyalty_referral_reward events are sent for automations. It reuses that plugin's connection, so there is nothing to set up; it only updates contacts that already exist (no contact is ever created) and never sends identifiers, subscription status or consent. (The email list reward is the one exception, and only for a member who presses Subscribe.) All requests run in the background. Settings → Integrations shows the status and has a button to send every existing member once (25 a minute). On by default
  • wcle_points_expiring action, fired when points enter the expiry warning window, even with the warning email off
  • wcle_guest_points_held, wcle_social_follow_bonus_granted, wcle_email_signup_bonus_granted actions; wcle_omnisend_contact_properties, wcle_omnisend_sync_enabled filters
  • WCLE_Settings::feature_amount() and WCLE_Settings::is_on(): read an earning amount with its Ways to earn switch applied

Changed

  • My Account → Rewards: "Follow us" is now "More ways to earn", holding the email list reward and the follow rewards ("Follow us on Instagram")
  • The guest orders toggle moved from the Earning tab to Ways to earn (same setting, so its value is kept)

Fixed

  • Refunds and status reversals took the customer from the order, so points earned by anyone else for that order (now: guest orders credited to an account) could never be clawed back. They now use whoever the earn row credited
  • Settings added in an update were missing until the plugin was reactivated: the screen showed new toggles as off, and saving any setting stored them as off. Upgrades now add defaults for new settings, without touching existing values
  • Deactivating or uninstalling left the daily birthday-bonus job scheduled

1.5.4
